summary: Run again: You lost again, and {close tie} asks whether you will run next time.
realLife: One life: He lost three Wisconsin governor's races, then won the 1957 special Senate election. Another: He lost the 2002 Newark mayoral race and won in 2006, when the incumbent did not run. Another: She lost a 2012 state house race to the speaker, then won a Seattle council seat in 2013.
weights: How many times you have lost.
choices: run again for the same office

branches.then: The next try comes as a special election, and the papers call you the one who never quits.

branches.when: the incumbent who beat you retires
branches.then: The next run is against someone else.
